definitions.explanation: A traditional form of manual therapy that treats bone fractures, joint dislocations, sprains, and musculoskeletal injuries through manipulation rather than surgery. In modern Japan, practiced by licensed judo therapists at clinics called 整骨院.

examples.japanese: ⟦{整骨院|せいこついん}→整骨院：18136_seikotsuin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: I go to a bonesetting clinic regularly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{痛|いた}めて→痛める：13613_itameru⟧⟦{整骨院|せいこついん}→整骨院：18136_seikotsuin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I hurt my lower back and received treatment at a bonesetting clinic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{整骨院|せいこついん}→整骨院：18136_seikotsuin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{肩|かた}こり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧みた。
examples.english: A new bonesetting clinic opened in front of the station, so I went to get my stiff shoulders treated.

examples.english: Bonesetting techniques are said to have developed from the resuscitation methods of judo.

notes:
Composed of {整|せい} (arrange, set in order) and {骨|こつ} (bone). {整骨|せいこつ} has its roots in traditional Japanese medicine, particularly the healing arts associated with ⟦{柔道|じゅうどう}→柔道：01612_juudou⟧. Practitioners were historically martial artists who knew how to set bones and treat injuries sustained during training.

In modern Japan, ⟦{整骨院|せいこついん}→整骨院：18136_seikotsuin⟧ (bonesetting clinics) are extremely common, found on virtually every commercial street. They are staffed by {柔道整復師|じゅうどうせいふくし} (judo therapists), who hold a national license. These clinics treat sprains, muscle strains, back pain, and similar musculoskeletal complaints. Some treatments are covered by health insurance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{整骨院|せいこついん}→整骨院：18136_seikotsuin⟧: bonesetting clinic
- {整骨|せいこつ}⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧: bonesetting treatment
- {整骨|せいこつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go to a bonesetting clinic
- {整骨|せいこつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧: to regularly visit a bonesetting clinic

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {接骨|せっこつ}: bonesetting — synonym; ⟦{接骨院|せっこついん}→接骨院：20981_sekkotsuin⟧ is an alternative name for the same type of clinic
- ⟦{整体|せいたい}→整体：27407_seitai⟧: chiropractic, body alignment therapy — a broader term for manual body adjustment; practitioners are not nationally licensed
- ⟦{整形外科|せいけいげか}→整形外科：22066_seikeigeka⟧: orthopedic surgery — the Western medical specialty; involves diagnosis, imaging, and sometimes surgery
